text:
anya: Draft operator runbook + telemetry contract for automatic fallbacks. PTAL. I sketched signals, decision API, and ops steps. Need: clear metric names, thresholds, event payload, and rollback playbook.

sahil: Nice. One question: do we rely on single SLI or composite? I'd prefer composite (latency P95 + error-rate + model-quality regression).

anya: Composite. Proposed signal names: infra.fallback.trigger.count, infra.fallback.trigger.reason, infra.fallback.decision.success, infra.fallback.decision.abort, infra.fallback.latency_p95_ms, infra.fallback.model_quality.delta.

jamie: For model-quality delta we need eval window and baseline. Suggest payload includes: baseline_model_id, candidate_model_id, metric_name, delta, window_minutes.

taylor: Also include TTL for the decision event so downstream consumers ignore stale triggers.

anya: Good. For the Decision API: POST /internal/v1/fallbacks/decision with body {service, route, trigger_ts, signals: {...}, suggested_action: 'switch'|'drain'|'no-op'}.

taylor: Add a 'provenance' field w/ reason+detector_id and memory of probe_ids so we can trace why a decision happened.

anya: Ops runbook steps (short):
1) Check dashboards -> infra.fallback.*
2) Confirm if automated action ran (infra.fallback.decision.success == 1)
3) If automated failed, run manual switch: curl -X POST to ops-api decision endpoint (snippet below)
4) Rollback: pin previous model and run canary at 5% then monitor for 30m.

sahil: Add snippet: 
```bash
# trigger manual fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"api","route":"/v1/generate","action":"switch","target":"model-2026-03-20"}' \
  https://ops-api/internal/v1/fallbacks/decision
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary monitor alarm configured: fallback-decider-primary (SLO breach) -> notify #oncall.

jamie: Telemetry contract note: All fallback events must include trace_id and optional request_sample (hashed). Do NOT include raw PII or sensitive request bodies.

taylor: Alerting: urgent if infra.fallback.decision.abort == 1 && abort_count>3 in 10m. Ops-runbook: escalate to infra oncall and open incident.

anya: Who wants to own writing the doc into /docs/rollouts? I can draft the first pass into the runbooks repo if someone adds the exact curl endpoint and example env values.

jamie: I can add dashboard panels and alert rules.

sahil: I'll add unit tests for emitter and ensure metrics use stable names (no runtime string interpolation).

anya: Thanks — I'll push a PR by EOD and link here. :thumbsup:
